templates.description: Passively hold the entire universe at equal weight, rebalancing periodically back to equal weight. The baseline every active strategy is measured against.
Hold each asset only while it is above its own trailing moving average AND has a positive trailing return; otherwise move that sleeve to cash. Also called trend following or absolute momentum.

lookback.description: trailing return lookback in trading days

sma_window.description: trend filter moving-average window in trading days

example_papers: Moskowitz Ooi Pedersen 2012 Time Series Momentum

templates.description: Rank the universe by trailing return and hold the top N names at equal weight, rebalancing each period. Relative-strength momentum.

lookback.description: trailing return lookback in trading days

top_n.description: number of top-ranked assets to hold

example_papers: Asness Moskowitz Pedersen 2013 Value and Momentum Everywhere

templates.description: Antonacci-style: pick the single best universe asset by trailing return (relative momentum), but only hold it if its return is also positive (absolute momentum); otherwise hold the safe asset.

lookback.description: trailing return lookback in trading days

templates.description: Per-asset mean reversion: enter long when RSI is oversold, exit to cash when RSI is overbought. Holds the position between thresholds.

rsi_window.description: RSI averaging window in trading days

oversold.description: RSI level below which to buy

overbought.description: RSI level above which to sell

example_papers: Connors Alvarez 2008 Short Term Trading Strategies

templates.description: Rotate into the top N momentum (sector) ETFs that are also above a long trend SMA; park sleeves that fail the trend filter in the safe asset.

lookback.description: trailing return lookback in trading days

top_n.description: number of top sectors to hold

trend_sma.description: trend filter SMA window in trading days

example_papers: Faber 2010 Relative Strength Strategies for Investing
